content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the removal of the logic that set unused color plane offsets to ~0xfff when the number of potential color planes increased to 4. This led to the possibility of stale offsets being used in calculations for the main surface and auxiliary surface, which could result in incorrect positioning and non-negative AUX_DIST values. The code was not properly handling the case where auxiliary planes were not needed, leading to potential inconsistencies in the display surface calculations.
